tickets.title: Coordinate business sale planning handoff
tickets.text: Briefly document the expected sale structure of Serena Cloudpuddle’s majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components, key advisors involved (CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle and attorney Celia Nettlewhisk), estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with the client’s CPA and attorney.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Liquidity Reserve Snapshot
tickets.text: Prepare a snapshot of Serena Cloudpuddle’s cash reserve needs, sizing the reserve to cover spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for her mother during the transition period.
tickets.evidence: The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother.

tickets.title: Coordinate estimated tax planning for Serena
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle to develop a post‑closing tax estimate for Serena Cloudpuddle’s sale proceeds, incorporating projected taxable income and applicable deductions.
tickets.evidence: Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available.

tickets.title: Collect sale documentation for Cloudberry Kite Components
tickets.text: Collect the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire instruction evidence for Serena Cloudpuddle’s sale of her majority interest in Cloudberry Kite Components and upload them to the advisory file.
tickets.evidence: Sale documentation remains needed by 2024-07-31 because only a summary term sheet was available, not the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, or wire instruction evidence.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Serena Cloudpuddle’s current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow‑up items for the lead advisor before any client‑facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: Evan noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change; an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23.
